name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a royalty and streaming company focused on gold and precious metals in Nevada and Idaho, operating within the prolific Walker Lane structural corridor. The company acquires royalties on exploration and pre-resource stage properties, and entered a $5M exploration stream earn-in at the Lapon Canyon project in Nevada in 2025. It trades on the OTCQX market and is building a royalty portfolio with the intent to package and sell royalty interests at higher valuations.
